# Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal

> Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal is an economist and AI and technology leader. As Head of AI & Technology she leads AI and software development: LLM agents, MCP servers, automation and data pipelines, and she evaluates how AI agents behave with people.

This site is the canonical profile of Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal, also known as Valentina Vanegas. The same person is https://www.linkedin.com/in/vvanegasa, https://github.com/vvanegasar, https://udemedellin.academia.edu/ValentinaVanegasAristiz%C3%A1bal and ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0004-7133-9367. Every English page has a Markdown version (append .md, or use the links below), and the Spanish version is under https://vvanegasar.github.io/es/.

## Expertise

- AI agents, MCP servers and voice AI: [AI agents in production](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/agents-in-production.md)
- LLM evaluation and AI sycophancy (cielo-bench, an open benchmark): [cielo-bench](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/cielo-bench.md)
- Data science and data engineering (Python, ETL, Power BI): [Sisbén IV data pipeline](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/sisben-etl.md)
- Economics and spatial econometrics: [About](https://vvanegasar.github.io/about.md) · [Talks](https://vvanegasar.github.io/talks.md)
- Software development, product and mobile apps (React Native): [A team and its products](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/team-and-product.md)
- Public speaking, debate and youth leadership: [Talks](https://vvanegasar.github.io/talks.md)

## Pages

- [Home](https://vvanegasar.github.io/index.md): Economist and AI leader. As Head of AI & Technology I lead AI and software development: LLM agents, MCP servers, automation, AI evaluation and data pipelines.
- [Work](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work.md): AI agents and an MCP server in production, a team shipping six products, a ~25M-record data pipeline and cielo-bench: AI, data science and software development.
  - [AI agents in production](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/agents-in-production.md): An MCP server that connects a SaaS product for US architecture and engineering firms to Claude, ChatGPT and Grok, and AI voice agents on real sales calls.
  - [A team and its products](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/team-and-product.md): Three developers across six products, from the first conversation with a customer to the production release.
  - [Sisbén IV data pipeline](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/sisben-etl.md): The first Power BI dashboard of Antioquia’s Planning Department and the Python pipeline behind it, built on ~25M records of Sisbén, the survey Colombia uses to target social programs.
  - [cielo-bench](https://vvanegasar.github.io/work/cielo-bench.md): Check or agree? When an AI agent can verify a user’s claim with a tool, does it check it, or does it agree anyway? An open benchmark with deterministic scoring and no LLM judge.
- [Talks](https://vvanegasar.github.io/talks.md): Moderated panels on economics and research, talks, Model UN coaching for public schools, youth workshops, and first places in public speaking.
- [About](https://vvanegasar.github.io/about.md): Economist and Head of AI & Technology: AI agents, MCP servers, data science and software development at a startup. Open to remote work and relocation.
- [Contact](https://vvanegasar.github.io/contact.md): Contact Valentina Vanegas Aristizábal about AI agents, building products with a small team, data and economics, or a talk, by form, email or LinkedIn.
